text.tspan: Spiky traffic: react fast, keep capacity cheap
Buffers in front: CloudFront cache, SQS queue, WAF rate limit
Spot above the base: mixed instances policy
scale out fast, scale in slow
Policies: target tracking (default) · step (big spikes) · simple (legacy) · scheduled (known times) · predictive (repeating patterns).
Leading metric beats CPU. Raise max_size and vCPU quotas before you need them. Spot gives a 2-minute warning:
never put stateful or non-interruptible work there.
